Method of Attack: Email campaign distributing zip attachments containing JavaScript files that download and execute the Locky ransomware executable
Use of anti-virtual machine code to evade analysis
Attack Vector: Email attachments with zip files containing JavaScript downloader scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Attachments named services_[name]_[6 random digits].zip, [name]_addition_[6 random digits].zip, or [name]_invoice_[6 random digits].zip
JavaScript files named addition-[random digits].js inside zip files
